name: ashui-components
description: Reusable HXX controls for ashui, with CSS styling and keyboard and pointer behaviors.
releasenote: A code editor: virtualized rows, gutter, minimap, decorations and markers, squiggles, completions, signature help and documentation popovers, and edits from code as one undo step. TreeItem makes its items when first opened. The icon element, Input icons, and <for> and <if> children in Select and Accordion. Coordinated control sizes, NumberInput and the number gauges. Uses ashui 0.1.3.
